Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 21:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + flagged quality diffs / suggested mitigations

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a clear runway: 

Recap (from today's demo)
- Primary goal: extract structured clinical notes and PII-normalized summaries at 2.5–5s latency per request for triage workflows.
- Current pain: occasional hallucination of medication names and inconsistency in dosage formatting when we switched to the 2027.04 model build in your sandbox.

What we recommend next
1) Shared eval pack: attached "novumhealth_eval_v1.zip" contains the prompt set, 250 de-identified examples, and scoring rubric we discussed. Please confirm we can run Redwood's sandbox evaluations against your sample dataset (no PHI leaves your environment).
2) Baseline model suggestion: start with redwood-open-llm-1.3-s (quantized) for throughput + redwood-open-llm-1.0 (full-fp) as the quality baseline. We'll include side-by-side diffs.
3) Short-term mitigation: we can pin your trial to the 2027.02-serving build (model variant id: rwlm-1.0-202702) to prevent regression while we investigate. Pinning is reversible; rollback plan below.
4) Security ask: please send the contact at security@novumhealth.com for SOC2 evidence; we'll push the SOC2 summary and the contract redlines to you by EOD tomorrow.
5) Next call: propose Thu 7/22 9am PT for a 20-min working session to review the eval results and pick a pin/rollback plan.

Attachments: novumhealth_eval_v1.zip (prompt set + rubric)

I'll put Marissa and Rishi on the thread to follow up on technical diffs and commercial timing.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
---

Elena — quick answers to your questions: 

- Pin behavior: yes — pinning a customer to a model variant (rwlm-1.0-202702) disables automatic promos to newer serving builds for that route in your environment until you explicitly unpin. We log pin events and you can schedule allowed updates.
- Cost impact: keeping a pinned fp32 variant vs switching to a quantized baseline may add ~20–40% per-token compute cost for inference at the volumes you shared. Extra eval runs are priced at a one-time eval fee + token consumption; estimate: $1.2k–$2.5k depending on run breadth. I'll have Rishi follow up with a formal cost estimate.
- SOC2 + egress: attaching our SOC2 one-pager in the Drive link (see related_links). For sandbox evals we support a containerized runner so no customer data leaves your VPC — we can describe that explicitly to your security team and provide HSM/KMS notes.

Action items I'm taking:
- Attach prompt set and a short guide to run the eval yourself (pushed to Drive, link below).
- Book Thu 7/22 9am PT — Marissa will present the diff approach.

Connor
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@novumhealth.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + flagged quality diffs / suggested mitigations

Elena / Connor — thanks for the context. I ran a brief side-by-side with a 50-example slice from the eval pack to illustrate the regression pattern. Summary (attached CSV: eval-results-summary.csv):

- Metric highlights (50-sample slice):
  • Exact match on medication entities: 88% (2027.02) -> 72% (2027.04)
  • Dosage normalization F1: 0.91 -> 0.76
  • Response latency (median): 1.9s (quantized run) vs 3.4s (fp32 2027.04)

Observations:
- The 2027.04 build introduced a tokenization tweak combined with an aggressive logit bias for numerics upstream of the medical entity layer; that appears to be producing truncated numeric tokens in some prompts (hence dosage formatting differences).

Recommended immediate mitigation:
1) Pin to rwlm-1.0-202702 for the NovumHealth route (prevents further automatic updates).
2) Deploy a temporary post-processing hook that normalizes dosage strings (we can ship this as a small lambda) — low development cost, fast improvement.
3) We'll prepare a targeted micro-fix to the tokenizer and push into the next canary; ETA 2–3 weeks.

Attachments: eval-results-summary.csv (50-sample diff), prompt_set_novum_v2.json (updated prompts that stress numerics)

I can present the diff live at the Thu call and walk through the failing examples. If you want us to do a full 250-sample run before the call we can, but it will add to the one-time eval fee (Rishi can outline).

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
